name: btn: Show Table Selector
purpose: Opens the table picker popover for a field map row. Copies the row's file and table into the schema selector, waits (pause indefinitely) until the picker returns, and if the user chose OK stores the file and table in the field map row and refreshes the field list.
writes:
SCHEMA::fileName#2 (step 3, global)
SCHEMA::tableName#1 (step 4, global)
FieldMap::file#3 (step 22, current record)
FieldMap::table#4 (step 23, current record)
open_question: Generator tooling that reads FileMaker design metadata; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product. The loop waits for the picker's result with Pause/Resume Script indefinitely (step 12).

name: btn: Choose
purpose: Picker button: closes the popover (allowing the close with a session flag) and returns the chosen value from the script parameter.

name: btn: Refresh Fields For Selected Table
purpose: Refreshes the Fields picker for the table chosen in the schema selector: gets its field names with the design_TableFields custom function, empties the Fields table and adds one record per field.

Fields::FieldName#1 (step 21, new record)
